content.text:
An Emboldened AMD Is Taking Direct Aim at Nvidia
Lost in a downbeat day for tech, was a big moment for Advanced Micro Devices. During an event Thursday afternoon called Advancing AI, the company made a compelling case that it’s becoming a true rival to Nvidia.
